claims.statement: Orzhov is the white-black guild of Ravnica, associated with religion, deals, hierarchy, debt, and organized crime.
The official Ravnica Allegiance guide says Orzhov began as a proper religious organization but emphasizes deals and business in its modern identity.
The guide describes Orzhov as a loose affiliation of cartels led by priests or kingpins.
The guide describes the Obzedat as the Ghost Council of Orzhova and historic leaders of the Syndicate.
The 2019 guide presents Kaya as taking control of the Orzhov after destroying the Obzedat, with Teysa installed as her right hand.
Afterlife is the Ravnica Allegiance signature mechanic associated with Orzhov.
Orzhov placement signals should weight obligation, social leverage, reputational structure, debt, legacy, and transactional clarity.
claims.notes: Placement inference derived from official faction identity and mechanics; not an official Wizards psychological taxonomy.
